records.title: Chronicles-OCR: A Cross-Temporal Perception Benchmark for the Evolutionary Trajectory of Chinese Characters
records.reason: Chronicles-OCR is a cross-temporal visual perception benchmark for VLLMs with a new annotation paradigm; it does not propose an inference-cost optimization.

records.title: Missing Old Logits in Asynchronous Agentic RL: Semantic Mismatch and Repair Methods for Off-Policy Correction
records.reason: The paper analyzes missing logits and exact/approximate correction for asynchronous agentic RL; its results concern post-training rollout throughput and correction, not production inference.

records.title: VideoSEAL: Mitigating Evidence Misalignment in Agentic Long Video Understanding by Decoupling Answer Authority
records.reason: VideoSEAL decouples planning from answer authority for long-video evidence alignment. It improves accuracy and grounding but does not report lower compute, memory, latency, token use, or serving load.

records.title: Probing Cross-modal Information Hubs in Audio-Visual LLMs
records.reason: The primary study identifies cross-modal sink tokens and proposes training-free hallucination mitigation through reliance on them. The method changes where information is read but does not prune tokens or demonstrate reduced latency/memory; the attention-sink connection is exploratory.

records.title: AssayBench: An Assay-Level Virtual Cell Benchmark for LLMs and Agents
records.reason: AssayBench is a virtual-cell/phenotypic-screen benchmark for LLMs and agents. Fine-tuning, ensembling, and prompt optimization in its evaluation improve task performance, not inference efficiency.
